pullRequest.title: Member and concession prices
pullRequest.body: Adds member and concession prices to the board. Members get 20% off and concessions £2 off the screening's price. They don't stack: someone who is both pays whichever is cheaper for them, as agreed at the October committee meeting.
pullRequest.author: sam

comments.body: The board shows members £8.00 for the Saturday matinee, which is more than the £7.50 everyone else pays. The discounts should come off the screening's own price.
